digest.component_or_area: Cloud/DC mutation coordinator and lifecycle framework
propositions: Every supported Cloud/DC mutation must route through exactly one typed coordinator/adapter path with no hidden generic retry wrappers, duck-typed fallbacks, or SDK-level retry owners reachable from production.
Unsupported production mutation actions must fail before any local or remote effect is applied, raising a typed provider-neutral error.

Preview, manifest, and log output must preserve existing mutation fields while adding versioned, redacted sections for logical-attempt lifecycle, delay/budget, disposition, fuse state, and retry_not_before data.

Cursor, baseline, and binding state must advance only for proven postconditions; deferred, failed, skipped, or commit-unknown work must remain eligible for re-observation and never be counted as applied.
The pre-observation repair boundary in reconcile.py must remain after staleness validation and before the first remote fetch, guarded by test_repair_runs_before_the_first_remote_observation.

Portable verified-fake Cloud/DC end-to-end test suites must cover mixed success, transient recovery, long-delay deferral, permanent failure, auth stop, fuse transitions, create containment, restart, and delivery failure scenarios without external credentials.
